messages.subject: cut out a day
parts:
Hi there!

 

Is it possible to cut out a single day in GGIR? We collect movement data at a school for a week. At one school, the week falls on Pentecost, so the kids wear the clocks 8 days (instead of 7) and we would like to cut out Pentecost Monday instead.

 

Thank you for your help.

 

Kind regards,

Elena

messages.author: 05de4f382b390d3d
messages.subject: Re: cut out a day
parts:
Dear Elena, 

In the case you are looking at the output from part 5, you may be interested in the data_cleaning_file, it will allow you to exclude that specific day from the part 5 report. See documentation here. 

Best,
Jairo
